content.bridge_context: Transitioning from Class 5, this story explores the concept of self-reliance and the 'magic' of hard work through a relatable school setting.

units.title: Hard Work vs. Magic
units.explanation: True success comes from our own effort, even when we think someone else is helping us.
units.dual_language_instruction: Reflect on a time you worked hard on a project. / उस समय के बारे में सोचें जब आपने किसी प्रोजेक्ट पर कड़ी मेहनत की थी।

units.title: The Concept of an 'Elf'
units.explanation: An elf is a small, magical creature from folktales, often known for helping or causing mischief.
units.dual_language_instruction: Visualize a tiny magical helper. / एक नन्हे जादुई सहायक की कल्पना करें।
